title: Document Worker result metadata and attribution-based output fallback
outcome: Public delegation docs describe optional host-owned Worker result fields, mutable locators, evidence provenance and the current output fallback and omission rules.
acceptance: The delegation feature doc and relevant architecture result/output section describe baseRevision, worktreePath and workerOutputUnavailable true/false/absent legacy semantics plus summaryFallback.

Docs distinguish child Notes, transcript command statuses, watcher observations and host verification, explain Worker changedFiles/canceled-command rules, and direct readers to the child transcript when unattributable output is deliberately suppressed.
